# Localtools

> 100% Free, client-side, zero-upload private browser tools for calculations, conversions, PDFs, images, finance, and code.

## About Localtools
Localtools runs all computation locally in the client browser using WebAssembly, Web Crypto, HTML5 Canvas, and modern Web APIs. No user data, files, or sensitive payloads are ever uploaded to a remote server.

## Tool Categories
- [Finance & Tax Tools](/tools/finance): Paycheck calculators for all 50 US states, sales tax, overtime, 1099 independent contractor tax, compound interest, loan payoff.
- [Business & Fee Calculators](/tools/business): Stripe fee calculator, PayPal fees, Shopify, Amazon FBA, eBay, Etsy, Upwork, Fiverr, reverse payout calculations.
- [Unit Converters](/tools/converters): High-precision 2-way conversion for length, mass, temperature, data storage, pressure, and volume.
- [Format & Code Tools](/tools/developer): In-browser WebP, PNG, JPG, CSV to JSON, JSON to YAML, Markdown to HTML, Base64, UUIDs, Hash functions.
- [PDF & Document Tools](/tools/pdf): Merge PDFs, split, compress, invoice generation, all client-side without upload.
